name: Slendytubbies 2 [BETA]
desc:
Slendytubbies 2 is a port of the original "Slendytubbies 2" by ZeoWorks made in 2014.

Investigate all the custards on different maps, alone, or with others.

To have a Custom Skin Texture you need to upload a decal on Roblox Creator page and then copy it's ID.

Original 2014 Game Creator:
